offers.description:
Join our inhouse Customer Operations team and be at the forefront of the electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution in Europe! At Fastned you can directly contribute to combating climate change by accelerating the transition to electric mobility. Together with 300+ colleagues with over 40 nationalities we have the ambition to build a European network of fast charging stations. We focus on prime locations where electric drivers can charge their vehicles with energy from the sun and wind. What sets us apart is our focus on sustainability and clean energy. As a member of the Fastned team, you'll be contributing to a greener future by supporting our mission to give freedom to electric drivers.

Your role

At Fastned, we pride ourselves on providing our customers with exceptional service and a top-notch charging experience. As our Dutch & English speaking Customer Support Agent, you will play a crucial role in upholding our commitment to customer satisfaction together with our dynamic team and helping us stand out from the competition.

offers.sharing_description: Fastned exists because twelve years ago, driving an electric car across Europe meant planning your route around whether you would make it. We have spent since 2012 building the answer: a fast-charging
offers.description:
Fastned exists because twelve years ago, driving an electric car across Europe meant planning your route around whether you would make it. We have spent since 2012 building the answer: a fast-charging network you can actually rely on, running entirely on solar and wind. More than 400 stations across nine countries now, on our way to 1,000 by 2030. Every one of them is a bet that clean energy wins on the commercial case as well as the moral one, and so far the bet is paying off. Building that network takes more than construction. It takes the teams behind it, and those teams are being built right now, which means you would have a hand in deciding how the work gets done rather than stepping into something already settled.

People work at height, near live electricity, next to motorway traffic, on sites run by contractors. Keeping them safe across the Netherlands and Belgium is the first half of this job.
